The claim-before-drafting rule did not prevent a collision: PRs #17142 and #17143 were opened minutes apart, both after an empty search. Re-searching right before the first scene (as the BIBLE says) would have caught it only if the other PR existed by then; a claim file or proposal-line marker committed to main would be stronger.
Its tag-spelling message suggests `--fix <post>`, but check_posts.py rejects --fix (unrecognized argument); fixed the tag by hand.
